//: Only what scripts/check-route-coverage.mjs cannot derive from the tree. A route's specs and captures are read from the path literals in e2e/ (see that script); an entry here adds `e2e` specs and `visual` captures that reach the route by clicks a literal cannot show, or an `exempt` reason saying why the route warrants less than both. `node scripts/check-route-coverage.mjs --write` prunes it; it never adds an exemption.

/ready/[token]/waiver.exempt: No capture of its own: the page is waiverSigningForm, the same form the waiver link draws and the waiver-active, waiver-rail and waiver-rail-follow-ups captures photograph; only the door differs, and it is held against a real record by src/app/(token)/ready/[token]/waiver-actions.test.ts. Reaching it in the visual suite means booking a seat on the demo shop's open trip, which moves every capture that counts that trip's seats (issue #2743).

/ready/[token]/waiver/doctor.exempt: The same DoctorReferralBody the waiver link's doctor page draws, which waivers.spec.ts walks and the waiver-doctor capture photographs; only the door differs, and that door (the readiness link, the seat's own record, the referral gate) is held against a real record by src/app/(token)/ready/[token]/waiver-actions.test.ts (issue #2743).

/shop/[shopSlug]/me/security.exempt: Browser coverage is real (e2e/security-settings.spec.ts enrols in two-factor against the frozen clock, reads the recovery codes and revokes a session). No capture, because the Active sessions card cannot hold a baseline still: account_sessions.updated_at is stamped by better-auth's own clock, which DIVEDAY_CLOCK does not reach, so "last seen" is the wall clock; the row beside it prints the Chromium user-agent string, version and all; and the row count depends on how often the run signed in. Masking those is the one fix AGENTS.md refuses. Closing this means stamping those timestamps through src/lib/clock.ts at the better-auth boundary, which is an auth change wanting its own review (issue #1020).

/shop/[shopSlug]/safety/print.exempt: No capture of its own yet: the sheet is the Safety screen's figures and lists on a PacketSheet, held figure for figure against the screen by src/app/shop/[shopSlug]/safety/print/page.test.tsx and row for row by SafetyLists.test.tsx, and reports.spec.ts opens it from the Print door. Its first baseline is cut in the visual-print layer (issue #2745).
